questions.content: Câu 1: Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences given. Plastic takes hundreds of years to decompose in the ground. That is harmful to the environment.
options: A. Plastic takes hundreds of years to decompose in the ground, that is harmful to the environment.
B. Plastic takes hundreds of years to decompose in the ground, in which is harmful to the environment.
C. Plastic takes hundreds of years to decompose in the ground, which is harmful to the environment.
D. Plastic takes hundreds of years to decompose in the ground, from which is harmful to the environment.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: Dùng "which" để thay cho toàn bộ mệnh đề trước (“Plastic takes hundreds of years to decompose in the ground”). Dịch nghĩa: Nhựa mất hàng trăm năm để phân hủy trong lòng đất, điều này gây hại cho môi trường.

questions.content: Câu 2: Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences given. Some users do not think twice about the comments they post on social media. This may have dreadful consequences.
options: A. Some users do not think twice about the comments they post on social media and which may have dreadful consequences.
B. Some users do not think twice about the comments they post on social media, which may have dreadful consequences.
C. Some users do not think twice about the comments they post on social media, which this may have dreadful consequences.
D. Some users do not think twice about the comments they post on social media, and which this may have dreadful consequences.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: Sử dụng "which" để thay thế cho cả mệnh đề trước: “the comments they post on social media.” Dịch nghĩa: Một số người dùng không suy nghĩ kỹ về các bình luận họ đăng trên mạng xã hội, điều này có thể dẫn đến hậu quả khủng khiếp.

questions.content: Câu 3: Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences given. They stayed for the weekend. That was great.
options: A. They stayed for the weekend, which was great.
B. They stayed for the weekend and which was great.
C. They stayed for the weekend, which it was great.
D. They stayed for the weekend and which it was great.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: Cấu trúc mệnh đề quan hệ rút gọn với "which" dùng để bổ sung thông tin cho cả câu trước. Dịch nghĩa: Họ ở lại cuối tuần, điều đó thật tuyệt.

questions.content: Câu 4: Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences given. She cycled from London to Glasgow. This is pretty good for a woman of 75.
options: A. She cycled from London to Glasgow, which it is pretty good for a woman of 75.
B. She cycled from London to Glasgow, and which is pretty good for a woman of 75.
C. She cycled from London to Glasgow, and which it is pretty good for a woman of 75.
D. She cycled from London to Glasgow, which is pretty good for a woman of 75.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: Dùng “which” để bổ sung ý cho cả mệnh đề trước. Không dùng “and which” hoặc thêm “it” vì sai cấu trúc. Dịch nghĩa: Bà ấy đã đạp xe từ London đến Glasgow, điều này thật đáng nể đối với một người phụ nữ 75 tuổi.

questions.content: Câu 5: Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences given. The movie turned out to be a blockbuster hit. This came as a surprise to critics.
options: A. The movie turned out to be a blockbuster hit which came as a surprise to critics.
B. The movie turned out to be a blockbuster hit which it came as a surprise to critics.
C. The movie turned out to be a blockbuster hit and which came as a surprise to critics.
D. The movie turned out to be a blockbuster hit, which came as a surprise to critics.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: Dùng dấu phẩy + which để bổ nghĩa cho cả mệnh đề trước. Đáp A thiếu dấu phẩy nên không đúng. Dịch nghĩa: Bộ phim hóa ra là một bom tấn, điều này khiến các nhà phê bình bất ngờ.

questions.content: Câu 6: Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences given. I always turn off the fans when I leave the room. That helps save energy.
options: A. I always turn off the fans when I leave the room and which that helps save energy.
B. I always turn off the fans when I leave the room, which it helps save energy.
C. I always turn off the fans when I leave the room, that helps save energy.
D. I always turn off the fans when I leave the room, which helps save energy.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: Dùng dấu phẩy + which để bổ nghĩa cho cả mệnh đề trước. Dịch nghĩa: Tôi luôn tắt quạt khi rời khỏi phòng, điều đó giúp tiết kiệm năng lượng.

questions.content: Câu 7: Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences given. My father has learned about planting trees in the garden. This contributes to a healthier environment.
options: A. My father has learned about planting trees in the garden, that contributes to a healthier environment.
B. My father has learned about planting trees in the garden, in which contributes to a healthier environment.
C. My father has learned about planting trees in the garden, and which contributes to a healthier environment.
D. My father has learned about planting trees in the garden, which contributes to a healthier environment.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: Dùng “which” để bổ nghĩa cho cả mệnh đề “has learned about planting trees…”. Dịch nghĩa: Bố tôi đã học cách trồng cây trong vườn, điều này góp phần tạo ra môi trường lành mạnh hơn.

questions.content: Câu 8: Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences given. I never turn on the TV when leaving a room. That helps save energy.
options: A. I never turn on the TV when leaving a room, and which helps save energy.
B. I never turn on the TV when leaving a room, in which helps save energy.
C. I never turn on the TV when leaving a room, at which helps save energy.
D. I never turn on the TV when leaving a room, which helps save energy.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: Dùng dấu phẩy + which để bổ nghĩa cho cả mệnh đề trước. Dịch nghĩa: Tôi không bao giờ bật TV khi rời khỏi phòng, điều đó giúp tiết kiệm năng lượng.
